extra.final_summary: Found and fixed several data issues affecting the average flipper length by species. First, body_mass_g had text numbers (e.g., '3,150') which were safely converted to numeric. One row (id 14) had an implausible body mass of 3,550,000 g and was excluded. Island names had case and space variants ('torgersen', 'Dream ') which were normalized to match the rules. Most critically, three flipper length values were negative (-215, -228, -198) and outside the valid range (170-235 mm); these were set to missing as likely data entry errors. After these fixes, the analysis used 63 rows. The average flipper length is 190.28 mm for Adelie, 199.64 mm for Chinstrap, and 215.14 mm for Gentoo penguins.
